qa_pairs.question: What is the difference in torque between M40/M42/M43/M44/M51 Automatic/M52 Automatic and all other transmissions for new micro-encapsulated screws?
qa_pairs.answer: M40/M42/M43/M44/M51 Automatic/M52 Automatic requires 120 Nm while all others require 105 Nm, a difference of 15 Nm.

qa_pairs.question: What section and subsection does this flywheel torque specification table belong to?
What type of screws are specified for the flywheel installation?
Are the flywheel bolts reusable according to this specification?
qa_pairs.answer: No, the specification calls for new micro-encapsulated screws and states that bolts are a component part of the flywheel.
